items.title: Workflow And Acceptance Plan
items.description: We walk through how your team books, dispatches, and bills loads today and agree, in writing, what each later sprint delivers and how you will judge it done.
bullets: Documented workflows for booking, dispatch, documents, and billing
Acceptance criteria for every sprint, agreed before build starts
Confirmed list of vendor accounts and API access needed for later sprints

items.title: Roles, Permissions And Data Ownership
items.description: Everyone gets the access their job needs and nothing more, and it is clear who owns each kind of record from day one.
bullets: Agreed role list with what each role can view, edit, and approve
Data ownership map covering customers, carriers, loads, and financials
Working sign-in with role-based access in place

items.title: Load Plus Assessment And Audit History
items.description: We review what your Load Plus exports contain and how they map across, and we switch on an audit trail so every change in the new platform is recorded from the start.
bullets: Load Plus import assessment with a field-by-field mapping
Sample import run on a copy of your data, with findings
Audit history recording who changed what, and when

items.title: Customer Records And Locations
items.description: Each customer has one record holding everything about them, including every location you pick up from or deliver to on their behalf.
bullets: Customer record with company details and notes
Multiple locations per customer with addresses and hours
Search and filter across all customers

items.title: Contacts And Billing Preferences
items.description: Every person you deal with at a customer is on file with their role, and billing goes to the right place in the right way every time.
bullets: Multiple contacts per customer, each with a role and contact details
Billing preferences per customer, including invoice recipients
Credit settings with limits visible to the people booking loads

items.title: Customer Load Defaults
items.description: The details a customer always wants are filled in for you, so repeat loads take less typing and fewer mistakes.
bullets: Customer-specific defaults applied when a new load is started
Defaults editable per customer by permitted roles
Clear indication on the load of which values came from defaults

items.title: Carrier Records And Identifiers
items.description: Every carrier you work with has one record, keyed on the identifiers your team already uses to look them up.
bullets: Carrier record with company and contact details
MC and DOT numbers stored and searchable
Insurance and authority fields with expiry dates

items.title: Preferred And Blocked Carriers
items.description: Your team can see at a glance who you prefer to use and who you never use, along with the notes that explain why.
bullets: Preferred and blocked status on each carrier
Priority notes shown wherever the carrier is selected
History of status changes with who made them

items.title: Booking Restriction Rules
items.description: The platform stops a load being booked with a carrier that should not have it, instead of relying on someone to remember.
bullets: Booking rules covering blocked status, insurance, and authority
Clear warning explaining why a carrier cannot be booked
Rules configurable by permitted roles

items.title: Load Details And Equipment
items.description: Everything a carrier needs to know about the freight is captured once, in a consistent shape, before the load goes anywhere.
bullets: Equipment type and refrigeration requirements
Cargo description, weight, and dimensions
PO and reference numbers attached to the load

items.title: Stops And Appointments
items.description: A load can carry as many pickups and deliveries as it needs, each with its own appointment, in the order the truck will run them.
bullets: Multiple stops per load, reorderable
Appointment date and time window for each stop
Stop-level references and instructions

items.title: Templates And Load Duplication
items.description: Lanes you run again and again become one-click starts, so your team builds repeat freight in seconds.
bullets: Saved load templates for recurring lanes
Duplicate any historical load as the start of a new one
Duplicated loads clearly marked as new until saved

items.title: Dispatch Board
items.description: One screen shows every active load and where it stands, so dispatchers know what needs attention without asking around.
bullets: Dispatch board with filters by status, date, and dispatcher
Status workflow from booked through delivered
Load detail available from the board in one click

items.title: Carrier, Driver And Dispatcher Assignment
items.description: Each load clearly shows which carrier, driver, and dispatcher own it, and hand-offs between dispatchers are recorded.
bullets: Carrier and driver assignment on each load
Dispatcher ownership with reassignment
Assignment history on the load

items.title: Booking Checks And Recorded Overrides
items.description: The platform checks each booking against your rules before it is confirmed. When someone has a good reason to proceed anyway, their override is permitted, recorded, and visible.
bullets: Booking checks with warnings shown before confirmation
Permission-controlled overrides with a required reason
Override log showing who overrode what, and why

items.title: Rate Tables And Supporting Uploads
items.description: Customer rates and carrier costs live in the platform with the paperwork that backs them up, instead of in spreadsheets and inboxes.
bullets: Rate tables for customer revenue and carrier costs
Supporting documents uploaded against rates
Accessorial charges added to customer and carrier sides

items.title: Margin Visibility
items.description: Every load shows what it earns before and after it is booked, so nobody finds a thin load at month end.
bullets: Margin calculated per load from revenue, costs, and accessorials
Margin shown on the load and on the dispatch board
Pricing amendments recorded with the change and who made it

items.title: Commission Allocations
items.description: When more than one person earns on a load, the split is set on the load itself and carries through to reporting.
bullets: Multiple commission allocations per load
Allocation rules by percentage or amount
Commission figures available for reporting

items.title: BOLs, Rate Confirmations And Agreements
items.description: The documents every load needs are generated from the load itself, so the details always match what was booked.
bullets: Bill of lading generated from the load
Rate confirmations and agreements generated from the load
Email and print straight from the load

items.title: Secure Carrier Acceptance
items.description: Carriers review and accept a rate confirmation on a secure page and fill in their driver details there, so nothing has to be keyed in twice.
bullets: Secure acceptance page for each rate confirmation
Driver details, seal number, and PRO number captured on acceptance
Acceptance recorded on the load with date and time

items.title: Document Versions And POD Uploads
items.description: Every version of every document is kept, and proof of delivery lands on the load as soon as it arrives.
bullets: Document version history on each load
POD upload attached to the load
Loads missing a POD flagged for follow-up

items.title: Tracking Provider Connections
items.description: We connect the tracking functions you need from Trucker Tools, MacroPoint, and Samsara, so location updates arrive on the load without anyone copying them across.
bullets: Agreed functions connected for Trucker Tools, MacroPoint, and Samsara
Tracking provider selected per load
Connection status visible to dispatchers

items.title: Location And Milestone Updates
items.description: Each load builds its own timeline of where the truck was and when it reached each stop.
bullets: Location updates stored with timestamps
Stop milestones updated from tracking data
Tracking timeline on the load

items.title: Tracking Exceptions
items.description: When tracking goes quiet or a truck is running late, the load is flagged so someone can act before the customer calls.
bullets: Exception rules for missed updates and late arrivals
Exceptions surfaced on the dispatch board
Exception history recorded on the load

items.title: Highway, MyCarrierPackets And RMIS Connections
items.description: We connect the carrier-service functions you rely on, so verification and onboarding information is in the platform rather than in separate tabs.
bullets: Agreed functions connected for Highway, MyCarrierPackets, and RMIS
Connection status and last sync time visible on the carrier
Errors from each service logged and surfaced

items.title: Carrier Matching And Verification Status
items.description: Results from each service are matched to the right carrier record and shown where your team makes booking decisions.
bullets: Carrier matching against MC and DOT numbers
Onboarding and verification status on each carrier
Mismatches flagged for review

items.title: Operational Controls
items.description: Verification results feed straight into the booking rules from Sprint 3, so an unverified carrier is caught at the point of booking.
bullets: Booking rules extended with verification results
Warnings when a carrier's status changes
Controls configurable by permitted roles

items.title: Sage 50 Data Exchange
items.description: Customer and financial data moves between the platform and Sage 50 in the ways agreed during discovery, without re-keying.
bullets: Agreed customer data exchange with Sage 50
Agreed financial data exchange with Sage 50
Sync history showing what moved and when

items.title: Invoice-Ready Handoff And Credit Visibility
items.description: Delivered loads are handed to accounting ready to invoice, and the people booking loads can see a customer's credit position.
bullets: Invoice-ready handoff for delivered loads
Customer credit position visible when booking
Loads held from handoff until required documents are in

items.title: Reconciliation And Sync Errors
items.description: When the two systems disagree, someone is told, and the discrepancy can be worked through rather than discovered later.
bullets: Reconciliation view comparing platform and Sage 50 figures
Sync errors logged with a clear reason
Retry for failed syncs once the cause is fixed

items.title: Operational And Financial Dashboards
items.description: Managers see how the business is running today and how it is performing financially, from data that is already in the platform.
bullets: Operational dashboard covering active loads and exceptions
Financial dashboard covering revenue, costs, margin, and commissions
Date and team filters on both dashboards

items.title: Priority Notes And Activity-Triggered Emails
items.description: The right people hear about the right things automatically, from a load that needs attention to a step that has just been completed.
bullets: Priority notes and exceptions summarized for each team
Activity-triggered emails for agreed events
Email rules editable by permitted roles

items.title: DAT Posting
items.description: If DAT stays in the agreed scope, loads can be posted, updated, and removed on DAT from the load itself.
bullets: Post, update, and remove loads on DAT from the platform
DAT posting status visible on the load
Confirmed during discovery whether DAT remains in scope

items.title: Final Migration And End-To-End Testing
items.description: Your live data comes across from Load Plus, and we run real loads through every step together before anyone relies on the new platform.
bullets: Final data migration from Load Plus
End-to-end test of booking, dispatch, documents, tracking, and accounting
Test results recorded against the acceptance criteria from Sprint 1

items.title: Client Acceptance And Corrections
items.description: Your team signs off against the criteria agreed at the start, and anything that falls short is corrected before launch.
bullets: Acceptance session with your team
Corrections made and re-tested
Written sign-off

items.title: Training, Cutover And Launch Verification
items.description: Your team is trained on the platform they will use every day, the switch from Load Plus happens on a planned date, and we confirm everything is working once it is live.
bullets: Role-based training sessions for your team
Planned cutover from Load Plus
Post-launch verification checks
